title: Step 62-D production Compare flow and deterministic URL state
description: Productionize only the Storefront Compare journey on top of canonical Step 62-C: deterministic repeated-product UUID URL state capped at four, fail-closed parsing, first-use state with no Compare traffic below two selections, server-only POST /compare/validate then POST /compare, authoritative price/comparable-specification rendering, remove-selection navigation, explicit route states, and deterministic Stage-D verification. Do not implement Wishlist UI, Product Detail/Listing integration, final Step-62 hardening, backend/OpenAPI/database/auth-platform changes, dependencies, or later stages.

acceptance_criteria.description: The production /compare route replaces the Step-62 placeholder and consumes the canonical Step-62-C bridge only; no direct browser API transport or parallel Compare DTO is introduced.

acceptance_criteria.description: Compare URL state accepts only repeated product UUIDs, fails closed on unknown keys/invalid IDs/duplicates/>4 selections, serializes deterministically, and issues no Compare request below two selections.

Backend POST /compare/validate remains compatibility authority and POST /compare supplies product identity/current Toman price/comparable specifications; the Storefront does not infer category compatibility or fabricate stock/discount/availability.
Compare table uses table header associations, explicit product-detail/remove navigation, first-use/error/recovery states and inherited RTL/focus-safe presentation without starting final 62-G claims.
